title: Multimodal RAG
description: Fixed operator-curated pathway from Tracker's Multimodal LLMs plan. No per-student curriculum generation.

learning_flow: Watch an associated video when present

topics.title: Read ViT paper — implement PatchEmbedding in PyTorch. Understand CLS token, positional encoding, Pre-LN blocks. Visualize attention maps.
topics.description: Read ViT paper — implement PatchEmbedding in PyTorch. Understand CLS token, positional encoding, Pre-LN blocks. Visualize attention maps.
objectives: Apply it in a small exercise

resources.title: ViT — An Image is Worth 16x16 Words
resources.content: Original Vision Transformer — splits image into 16x16 patches, treats as tokens, feeds into standard transformer. Foundation for DINO, DINOv2, MAE, Swin, SAM, LLaVA. Read before any ViT-based paper.

topics.title: Read SimCLR — understand NT-Xent contrastive loss, augmentation pairs, projection head. Foundation for CLIP training.
topics.description: Read SimCLR — understand NT-Xent contrastive loss, augmentation pairs, projection head. Foundation for CLIP training.
objectives: Apply it in a small exercise

resources.title: SimCLR — Contrastive Self-Supervised Learning
resources.content: Simple framework for contrastive learning — two augmented views of same image pulled together, different images pushed apart. Foundation for understanding CLIP contrastive training.

topics.title: Clone CLIP repo, run zero-shot image classification on 10 custom images. Understand joint embedding space and cosine similarity scoring.
topics.description: Clone CLIP repo, run zero-shot image classification on 10 custom images. Understand joint embedding space and cosine similarity scoring.
objectives: Apply it in a small exercise

resources.title: CLIP (OpenAI)
resources.content: Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining — foundational vision-language model, zero-shot image classification via text prompts. Natural fit with his CNN/OpenCV background.

topics.title: Read DINO — student-teacher self-distillation without labels. Visualize attention maps showing emergent segmentation. Compare to MAE.
topics.description: Read DINO — student-teacher self-distillation without labels. Visualize attention maps showing emergent segmentation. Compare to MAE.
objectives: Apply it in a small exercise

resources.title: DINO (original) — Self-Supervised Vision Transformers
resources.content: Original DINO self-distillation paper (v1) — student-teacher ViT without labels. Emergent segmentation. Direct precursor to DINOv2. Yannic Kilcher video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=h3ij3F3cPIk

topics.title: Read MAE — 75% patch masking + pixel reconstruction. Compare to BERT masking. Understand data-efficient pretraining.
topics.description: Read MAE — 75% patch masking + pixel reconstruction. Compare to BERT masking. Understand data-efficient pretraining.
objectives: Apply it in a small exercise

resources.title: MAE — Masked Autoencoders
resources.content: Mask 75% of image patches, reconstruct pixels — BERT for vision. Kaiming He et al. (Meta). Data-efficient SSL baseline before DINOv2. Yannic Kilcher video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Dp6iICL2dVI

topics.title: Run DINOv2 inference on custom images. Use as visual backbone — integrate into DocCluster for image embeddings.
topics.description: Run DINOv2 inference on custom images. Use as visual backbone — integrate into DocCluster for image embeddings.
objectives: Apply it in a small exercise

resources.title: DINOv2 (Meta)
resources.content: Self-supervised vision transformer — learns powerful visual features without labels. State-of-the-art on depth estimation, segmentation, classification. Pairs well with CLIP for multimodal projects.

topics.title: Read Flamingo — frozen vision encoder + Perceiver Resampler + gated cross-attention into frozen LLM. Run OpenFlamingo 4-shot VQA.
topics.description: Read Flamingo — frozen vision encoder + Perceiver Resampler + gated cross-attention into frozen LLM. Run OpenFlamingo 4-shot VQA.
objectives: Apply it in a small exercise

resources.title: Flamingo — Visual Language Model for Few-Shot Learning
resources.content: Bridges frozen vision encoder + LLM via cross-attention layers — interleaved image/text input, few-shot multimodal tasks. Single model outperforms fine-tuned task-specific models. DeepMind, 2022.

topics.title: Read BLIP-2 — Q-Former two-stage training. Understand why 188M trainable params beats Flamingo-80B with 54x fewer params. Load from HuggingFace.
topics.description: Read BLIP-2 — Q-Former two-stage training. Understand why 188M trainable params beats Flamingo-80B with 54x fewer params. Load from HuggingFace.
objectives: Apply it in a small exercise

resources.title: BLIP-2 — Bootstrapping Language-Image Pre-training
resources.content: Lightweight Q-Former bridges frozen image encoder + frozen LLM. Outperforms Flamingo80B by 8.7% on zero-shot VQAv2 with 54x fewer trainable params. Salesforce, 2023.

topics.title: Read InstructBLIP — instruction-aware Q-Former. Compare zero-shot vs BLIP-2 on 20 custom images across 3 task types (VQA, captioning, OCR).
topics.description: Read InstructBLIP — instruction-aware Q-Former. Compare zero-shot vs BLIP-2 on 20 custom images across 3 task types (VQA, captioning, OCR).
objectives: Apply it in a small exercise

resources.title: InstructBLIP — Instruction Tuning for Vision-Language Models
resources.content: Instruction-aware Q-Former on BLIP-2 — trained on 26 datasets, SOTA zero-shot on 13 held-out benchmarks. Standard architecture for generalizable VLMs. Salesforce, 2023.

topics.title: Read LLaVA — compare linear projection vs Q-Former. Understand why GPT-4 instruction data quality matters more than architecture complexity.
topics.description: Read LLaVA — compare linear projection vs Q-Former. Understand why GPT-4 instruction data quality matters more than architecture complexity.
objectives: Apply it in a small exercise

resources.title: LLaVA — Visual Instruction Tuning
resources.content: First visual instruction-tuned VLM — CLIP visual encoder + LLaMA LLM + projection layer. Two-stage training: align then fine-tune. Foundation of GPT-4V style models.

topics.title: Build: Multimodal DocCluster — InstructBLIP/LLaVA generates text from images/figures in docs → EmbedAnything embeds all content → PageIndex indexes → FastAPI serves multimodal QA. Stack: InstructBLIP
topics.description: Build: Multimodal DocCluster — InstructBLIP/LLaVA generates text from images/figures in docs → EmbedAnything embeds all content → PageIndex indexes → FastAPI serves multimodal QA. Stack: InstructBLIP + EmbedAnything + PageIndex + FastAPI
objectives: Apply it in a small exercise

topics.title: [DEFERRED — after mm.10] SAM — Segment Anything. Universal segmentation via prompts. ViT backbone + mask decoder. Read after completing Tier 3.
topics.description: [DEFERRED — after mm.10] SAM — Segment Anything. Universal segmentation via prompts. ViT backbone + mask decoder. Read after completing Tier 3.
objectives: Apply it in a small exercise

resources.title: SAM — Segment Anything Model (Meta)
resources.content: Universal image segmentation via point/box/text prompts — trained on 1B masks, 11M images. ViT backbone + lightweight mask decoder. SAM 2 extends to video.

topics.title: [DEFERRED — object detection track] FPN/BiFPN — multi-scale feature pyramid for detection. Read only if doing detection work.
topics.description: [DEFERRED — object detection track] FPN/BiFPN — multi-scale feature pyramid for detection. Read only if doing detection work.
objectives: Apply it in a small exercise

resources.title: Feature Pyramid Networks (FPN / BiFPN)
resources.content: Multi-scale feature extraction for object detection — bottom-up + top-down pathways. BiFPN adds bi-directional weighted fusion (EfficientDet). Required for DETR understanding.

topics.title: [DEFERRED — object detection track] DETR — first transformer detector, no anchors/NMS. Prereq: L55.
topics.description: [DEFERRED — object detection track] DETR — first transformer detector, no anchors/NMS. Prereq: L55.
objectives: Apply it in a small exercise

resources.title: DETR — End-to-End Object Detection with Transformers
resources.content: First transformer-based object detector — no anchors, no NMS, Hungarian matching. Direct ancestor of RF-DETR. Yannic Kilcher video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=T35ba_VXkMY

topics.title: [DEFERRED — object detection track] Deformable DETR — fixes DETR slow convergence. Read after L57.
topics.description: [DEFERRED — object detection track] Deformable DETR — fixes DETR slow convergence. Read after L57.
objectives: Apply it in a small exercise

resources.title: Deformable DETR
resources.content: Fixes DETR's slow convergence via deformable attention — attends to sparse key points not full feature map. Bridge between DETR and RF-DETR. Aleksa Gordić video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BNFNsLMlJqg

topics.title: [DEFERRED — autonomous driving track] BEVFormer — bird's eye view from multi-camera. Only if branching into AV.
topics.description: [DEFERRED — autonomous driving track] BEVFormer — bird's eye view from multi-camera. Only if branching into AV.
objectives: Apply it in a small exercise

resources.title: BEVFormer
resources.content: Bird's Eye View representation from multi-camera images via spatiotemporal transformers. Tesla FSD-style multi-camera fusion. +9 NDS over prior SOTA on nuScenes.

topics.title: [DEFERRED — autonomous driving track] World Models for AV — generative spatio-temporal models. Read after BEVFormer.
topics.description: [DEFERRED — autonomous driving track] World Models for AV — generative spatio-temporal models. Read after BEVFormer.
objectives: Apply it in a small exercise

resources.title: World Models for Autonomous Driving
resources.content: Generative spatio-temporal neural systems that compress sensor observations into latent state and roll forward under actions — enabling vehicles to simulate futures. Curated paper list + GAIA-2 reference.

milestones.title: Complete Multimodal RAG foundations
milestones.description: Finish the fixed pathway and produce evidence through sessions and assessments.
